description: 一件の競売物件の構造化データを取得. Fetch one auction by case_id (e.g. "bit_00000078922"). Returns case_number, court, property_type, sale_base_price_jpy, bid_floor_jpy (= base × 80%), deposit_jpy, bid_period, opening_date, address, photos, source_url (BIT), and _canonical (cite this). Free. Brand-isolated from the subsidies module.
name: get_auction_detail
